meta.name: heznpc
meta.tagline: Systems across AI, trust, local tools, and cultural data
meta.bio: Heznpc builds small, inspectable systems that turn messy workflows into usable tools.
meta.thesis: This hub is a portfolio map, not a repo dump. Work is grouped by the problem it proves: AI learning localization, local trust, developer presentation, local-first workflow tools, cultural archives, marketplace experiments, and future physical-computing systems.

areas.label: AI learning localization
areas.summary: Browser-based learning tools where translation, glossary control, and tutor UX need to stay bounded.
areas.current: Use course-specific flows as proof, not generic translation claims.
areas.frontier: Evaluation, permission hygiene, and first-user proof before stronger public claims.

areas.label: Trust and local diagnostics
areas.summary: Local checks that explain risk without turning the user machine into a telemetry source.
areas.current: Prefer readable reports, opt-in lookups, and artifact hygiene over broad security promises.
areas.frontier: Local device trust, agent-tool governance, and privacy-preserving diagnostics.

areas.label: Developer presence and publishing
areas.summary: Composable presentation surfaces for code, docs, and project evidence.
areas.current: Show verified artifacts and examples instead of rankings or soft metrics.
areas.frontier: A portfolio layer that stays current without inflating unfinished work.

areas.label: Local-first workflow tools
areas.summary: Small utilities for private work queues, reversible file operations, and personal automation.
areas.current: Keep these as lab proof until restore, install, and synthetic demo paths are clean.
areas.frontier: Human-controlled tools that can later bridge into physical and edge workflows.

areas.label: Cultural data and archive UX
areas.summary: Static and mobile-first viewers for niche datasets where provenance and scope matter.
areas.current: Useful as UX/data examples, not as central product claims.
areas.frontier: Clear source boundaries, mobile proof, and better refresh evidence.

areas.label: Marketplace experiments
areas.summary: Trust-heavy product ideas that are still below service-ready evidence.
areas.current: Do not present as launched services until payment, dispute, and safety flows are verified.
areas.frontier: Narrow state-machine prototypes before any public marketplace framing.

areas.label: Physical computing frontier
areas.summary: Future work at the boundary of local software, sensing, devices, and edge intelligence.
areas.current: Direction only; no representative repo is claimed yet.
areas.frontier: IoT and physical-system work should inherit the same local trust and evidence rules.

projects.name: skillBridge
projects.description: Course-focused browser extension for translation, glossary control, and inline tutor flows.
projects.evidence: Large local quality surface: unit tests, lint, formatting, locale checks, screenshots, and release scripts.
projects.constraint: Public listing, region availability, and latest released version must be verified before claiming traction.

projects.name: ProfileKit
projects.description: Composable SVG profile and project cards by URL.
projects.evidence: Local checks and tests cover rendering, URL safety, and endpoint behavior.
projects.constraint: Canonical hosting and some endpoint docs need freshness checks before stronger adoption claims.

projects.name: pc-health-check
projects.description: Local PC diagnostic reports for compatibility and trust checks.
projects.evidence: Rule tests and release smoke checks exist, with a local-first report model.
projects.constraint: Public examples should use sanitized output and avoid implying a complete security product.

projects.name: TR-STORY
projects.description: Mobile-first story viewer for a bounded cultural archive.
projects.evidence: Static export, data snapshot, and basic tests are present.
projects.constraint: External content boundaries and data freshness need to stay visible.

projects.name: tr-archive
projects.description: Fan-archive style viewer and utility surface with search and static data flows.
projects.evidence: Route breadth, headers, search, and app structure are substantial.
projects.constraint: Current local test failures and unofficial-content boundaries keep it below case-study level.

projects.name: academy-lens
projects.description: Sibling experiment for course-page translation and terminology preservation.
projects.evidence: Local static checks and unit tests exist.
projects.constraint: Still a beta/local-install project; store readiness and live QA should not be implied.

projects.name: aispool
projects.description: Local inbox for reviewing and promoting AI-work session candidates.
projects.evidence: Small CLI and tests exist with local-only data assumptions.
projects.constraint: Any public demo must be synthetic; real local metadata should never be shown.

projects.name: mothball
projects.description: Git-aware project archiver exploring reversible cleanup flows.
projects.evidence: Swift package structure and restore round-trip tests are present.
projects.constraint: Pre-alpha and file-operation-adjacent; not an end-user cleaner yet.

projects.name: cuk-sw-community
projects.description: Community-app skeleton being reframed as an owner-write archive.
projects.evidence: Auth, storage, rate-limit, and archive-mode code paths exist.
projects.constraint: Do not describe it as a live community service.

projects.name: dol-pin
projects.description: C2C rental marketplace prototype for event goods.
projects.evidence: Planning, app structure, and trust-flow code exist.
projects.constraint: Payment, dispute, safety, and dirty-worktree risks keep it out of the public front layer.

projects.name: hello-project
projects.evidence: Static visualization and scoped dataset exist.
projects.constraint: Best kept as archive proof unless provenance and mobile proof are refreshed.
